integrity: The exact algebra and unique-root inequality follow from the supplied independent generator-construction script; numerical eigenvalue finite differences are supplementary checks only.
scientific_limitations: Three sites only, with unit boundary and internal hop rates and a single middle bulk exchange site with equal positive adsorption/desorption rate.
The theorem concerns long-time covariance rates of accepted events, not instantaneous occupation correlations, finite-time distributions, general rates or large-chain scaling.
Broader previously published unindexed formulas might cover this specialization; independent literature audit has not been performed.
title: Exact five-channel counting-noise classification for a three-site TASEP with Langmuir exchange
